GA.name: Contribution des patentes, stated profession: architect or design office employing more than 2 persons, Libreville / Port-Gentil (tableau A, class 3, 170 000 F)
GA.statute: CGI 2025 art. 252-253 and the tariff annexed under art. 271 (tableau A)
GA.doc: art. 253: the patente is a fixed duty set by the general tariff for the professions of tableau A, or the exceptional tariff of tableaux B and C; the annexed tariff gives, for 'Architecte ou Bureau d'études (tenant un) — employant plus de 2 personnes', tableau A, class 3, 170 000 F (Libreville or Port-Gentil column). Every company line is taken to carry on that profession in one establishment in Libreville.
unsupported: the trade of the company is not in the input: one stated profession is applied to every company
other towns' columns and other professions (tableaux A, B, C)

KM.name: Contribution des patentes, stated profession: wholesale general-merchandise trader in a capital of the islands (150 000 F + 1/10 of rental value + 30 % communal centime)
KM.statute: CGI 2022 (updated to 1 January 2022) art. 165-166, 171, 179, 193 (L.F. 2021) and the annexed tariff ('Marchandises générales (Marchand de) — en gros'); LF 2023-2025 not checked
KM.doc: art. 165: the patente is a fixed duty and a proportional duty under the annexed tariff; art. 166: the fixed duty is set by the activity and reduced by 20 % outside the islands' capitals; art. 171: the proportional duty is on the rental value of the premises; tariff: general-merchandise trader, wholesale, fixed duty 150 000 FC, proportional duty 10e (one tenth of the rental value); art. 193 (L.F. 2021): a communal additional centime of 30 % on the patente. Every company line is taken to be such a trader in Moroni.
unsupported: the trade of the company is not in the input: one stated profession is applied to every company
20 % reduction of the fixed duty outside the islands' capitals (art. 166)
retail traders 50 000 FC and the other activities of the tariff

KM.name: Vignette automobile et droit de stationnement (vehicles up to 5 years old, by fiscal horsepower, + 1 000 FC parking duty)
KM.doc: art. 432: vehicles up to 5 years old 0-5 CV 9 000 FC, 6-9 CV 12 000, 10-12 CV 18 000, 12 CV and more 22 500 (6-10 years: 6 000 / 9 000 / 12 000 / 18 000; 11-20 years: 3 000 / 6 000 / 9 000 / 12 000), and a parking duty of 1 000 FC per car, added here to each amount. The vehicle's age is not in the input: vehicles are taken to be at most 5 years old.

TD.name: Taxe sur les véhicules de tourisme et breaks des sociétés (by fiscal horsepower)
TD.statute: CGI 2016 art. 199 (LF 2023, the DGI circular on LF 2024 and LF 2025 checked: art. 199 not amended)
TD.doc: art. 199 I: passenger cars and estate cars belonging to companies up to 7 CV 80 000 F, above 7 and up to 11 CV 120 000 F, above 11 CV 160 000 F; II: cars more than 5 years old at the balance-sheet date are reduced by 50 %, those over 10 years exempt. Households' cars are outside this tax (nil tariff here).
unsupported: 50 % reduction for cars over 5 years and exemption over 10 years (age not in the input: cars taken as at most 5 years old)
taxe pour la protection de l'environnement on vehicle owners (art. 200-202)
